Create a pane by splitting an existing pane

Usage: herdr pane split [OPTIONS] [PANE_ID]

Options:
      --direction <DIRECTION>  Split direction [possible values: right, down]
      --ratio <RATIO>          Fraction assigned to the new pane
      --cwd <CWD>              Working directory for the new pane
      --no-focus               Keep focus on the existing pane
  -h, --help                   Print help
